title: Tennis: Alex Eala marches past Australia's Jones to 2nd round in Hong Kong
summary: Filipina tennis star Alex Eala shrugged off a late change in opponents to advance to the second round of the Hong Kong Tennis Open on Tuesday night in Victoria Park.
